systems_found: Seven independent public universities with their own boards (UO, OSU, PSU, OIT, SOU, WOU, EOU), coordinated by the Higher Education Coordinating Commission (HECC)
17 independent community college districts (PCC, Lane, Chemeketa, Mt. Hood, etc.)

sources.institution: Oregon state agencies (not universities or community colleges)
sources.system: State of Oregon Transparency / DAS on data.oregon.gov (Socrata)
sources.institutions_covered: state agencies only; no university or community college agencies matched 'UNIV', 'COLLEGE' or 'HIGHER' (HECC is a state agency and may appear under another name)
sources.notes: Does not help: it has NO employee names and does not cover universities (independent since 2014) or community colleges (local districts). Recorded so it is not re-checked.

sources.system: UO Office of Public Records request log
sources.notes: The public log shows that full payroll files (name, title, department, salary) have been released to requesters (e.g. 2019-269, 2025-519), but the released files are not posted. You would need your own public records request (a form/email, possibly with fees).

sources.institution: Oregon public universities and state agencies (UO, OSU, PSU, etc.)
sources.coverage_years: multi-year incl. 2025 (558,282 salary records per search snippet)
sources.institutions_covered: state agencies plus UO, OSU, PSU (some rows from OpenTheBooks' own open-records requests)
sources.blocker: Anti-bot 'Client Challenge' (HTTP 403) on automated requests; search results capped at 10,000 rows; no bulk download.
sources.notes: The only person-level source found that covers Oregon universities; third-party, built from records requests.

private_extra: None found; Reed College, Lewis & Clark, Willamette and University of Portland publish only IRS 990 data.
gaps: No official published person-level pay for any Oregon public university or community college. The state DAS salary dataset has no names and excludes higher ed. Getting real data means public records requests to each of the 7 universities and 17 community colleges (UO's log shows it routinely releases payroll spreadsheets). No news-organization salary database found (Oregonian, Statesman Journal, Salem Reporter).
notes: Did not check each of the 7 universities' and 17 community colleges' HR sites individually: searches turned up no posted salary lists, and UO's public records site shows the data is handled only by request. Rated OpenTheBooks C because it is blocked to automated access.
